I received fertilizer coupons through the FISP program again this year, so I will put the chemical fertilizer and hybrid seed on this plot since it is my main maize field and I want a good harvest for my family. The plot is small, only 0.10 hectares, so my children and I can do all the work ourselves without paying for hired labor. I do not have enough manure for this plot, and I will rely on the rains because there is no water source nearby for irrigation.
